judgment_calls.topic: Distinguishing current attempt from past-year act
judgment_calls.decision: Current attempt = unqualified Suicide attempt / Intentionally harming self (also the trigger); past-year act = same concept with 'In the past' qualifier and onset within 1 year.
judgment_calls.alternatives: Use one unqualified concept for both (makes the past-year branch redundant with Q1 and over-triages past acts as current attempts).
